text:
Noah: quick decision needed  which two Optimize features to focus this sprint: (1) Console batching/cache hints, (2) eval-triggered alerts, (3) quantization recs?
Priya: 1 + 2. Hints = fast wins for customers. Alerts = necessary for quality gating.
Evan: +1. Alerts must have debounce and "confirm" default. Otherwise teams will ignore them.
Sana: quant recs are valuable but require benchmark infra  suggest spike next sprint.
ops-bot: note: limited eval runner quota this week.
Noah: MVPs proposed:
- Hints MVP: top-3 route batching suggestion + cache TTL presets + estimated cost delta.
- Alerts MVP: eval-driven concordance or embedding drift alerts, feature-flagged, require 2 consecutive failing runs, 24h quiet window, default to "confirm before notify".
Priya: rough sizing: Hints ~5 dev-days, Alerts ~7 dev-days if we reuse eval infra.
Evan: SLI ask: pilot FP rate <10%. Also need rollback toggle in Console.
Sana: I'll scope quant spike for next sprint and capture required benchmarks.
Noah: decision: ship Hints + lightweight Alerts behind FF for pilot. Priya create tickets OPT-900/901/902. Reconvene Wed for go/no-go. :thumbsup:
